possibilities.connection: Robocurve's coding-agent harness reached 97% on real trials but dedicated robot models stay 4x faster, and FastRUA attacks exactly that latency by overlapping planning with motion so robots move 84% of the time instead of 24%.

appearances.newly_possible: A real-robot agent can move 84% of the time instead of 24% by overlapping planning with motion and merging tool-call round trips.
appearances.why: Agent latency, not motor speed, is what makes LLM-driven robots slow, and this attacks it directly.

appearances.read: LLM-driven robots are slow mostly because they wait on the agent, and overlapping planning with motion recovers much of that time.
